description: PSQ-2 v2: Class-balanced LoRA fine-tune with 1-3 step examples. Tests generalization to 4-8 step sequences. Fixes v1 class imbalance (87.5% of v1 training was answer=0).
scientific_question: Does 1-3 step training generalize to 4-8 step compositional sequences?
v1_lesson: v1 failed (60.2%) due to class imbalance (87.5% answer=0 in training) and no multi-step exposure
